goal: Prevent outbound connection drops to IPv6 peers when using Tor SOCKS5 proxies
Ensures Tor exit relays properly parse destination addresses and ports
agreement: Author resolved an initial query by noting Tor already tracks the upstream issue (darosior)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes outbound connection drops to 20% to 30% of IPv6 peers reached via Tor
Tor exit nodes misparse compressed IPv6 addresses and drop connections with general failure
